name: @docxtor/editor
description: Docxtor's document editor: real pages, lossless .docx, bytes in and bytes out. Framework-free; also a <docxtor-editor> element.

scripts.wasm: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/docxtor-spell --target web --release --no-opt --out-dir ../../packages/editor/src/spelling/wasm --out-name spell && rm -f packages/editor/src/spelling/wasm/.gitignore packages/editor/src/spelling/wasm/package.json && node scripts/strip-wasm-names.mjs packages/editor/src/spelling/wasm/spell_bg.wasm
